rows.text: returns 0 in `eax` when the call it makes returns -1 (32-bit compare) and the incoming `edx` otherwise: when qword `rcx+0x10` is non-null it calls `0059FD10` + 0x1A with that qword, `rdx` and 1; otherwise when qword `rcx+8` is not -1 it calls through the import pointer at `0059FD10` + 0x4B with that qword, `rdx`, 0 and 1; otherwise when qword `rcx+0x20` is greater than 0 (signed) it calls `0059FD10` + 0x72 with that qword, `rdx` and 1, and when it is 0 or less it returns 0 without a call
